propositions: Cloud ADF codec must encode Markdown descriptions and comments as structured ADF (not plain-text paragraphs) to preserve headings, lists, code, and emphasis through the production send path
Data Center wiki codec must render Markdown to Jira wiki markup for descriptions and comments without content erosion or lossy round-trip, with fallback when pandoc is absent or times out

Echo-safety mechanism (per-binding baseline + normalize_outbound + change-gated rich_sha) must suppress unchanged second-pass re-emits and detect concurrent edits via three-way comparison while preserving Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates)
Append-only comment ID map must route newly created comments through the same rich-text codec as descriptions and persist Jira comment IDs without syncing edits or deletes
Live DC harness must exercise the production cutover against a real Jira DC instance and verify rendered HTML via expand=renderedFields without silent data loss

Idempotent Markdown↔ADF round-trip and monotonic DC render stability must hold over committed stratified corpus fixtures with measured thresholds, and git-delta cost must remain ≤0.07 KB per stable version
